name: publication_media
description: Each media item of a retained publication with the display rendition delivered to screens; the publication media guard keeps these items from being deleted or purged.
lifecycle: Inserted with its publication; never updated. Deleted when the publication is pruned or deleted.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the publication; immutable (tenant key).
Publication that references the media item.
SHA-256 of the display rendition the manifest names.
Media type of the display rendition.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, media_asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The media item belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, publication_id) REFERENCES publications(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The publication belongs to the same company; rows go with it.
One row per media item and publication.
The rendition digest is a 32-byte SHA-256.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX publication_media_asset_idx ON public.publication_media USING btree (company_id, media_asset_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the retained publications that protect a media item.
